item.title: Ore no Kanojo ga Shuushoku Shita Kaisha wa, Black Kigyou Datta...
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lune Team Bitters
  • 発売日: 2016-02-26
  • スコア: 6.8/10 (82 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺の彼女が就職した会社は、ブラック企業だった…。
  • 英語名: Ore no Kanojo ga Shuushoku Shita Kaisha wa, Black Kigyou Datta…

别名

  • ルネソフトプレミアムパック4 ～こんなに入れちゃって、どうするのよ!‛？～

あらすじ

The protagonist, Hiraga Ryuuichi, graduates from university and joins a mid-range electronics manufacturer as a first-year salesman. While being worked hard by his boss as a new member of the sales department, he spends fulfilling days. His girlfriend, Kisaragi Ami, whom he had been dating since college, has decided to join a major restaurant company and the two of them enjoy a brief rest before the start of her training. As time passes, they become unable to see each other as they cannot find time due to their work. However, they frequently exchange emails and phone calls, and their relationship grows stronger through occasional dates. During their dates, Ryuuichi begins to feel a sense of discomfort that he cannot put into words. He notices that Ami praises her company and boss more often and frequently cuts their dates short due to calls from her boss. Despite this, Ryuuichi is impressed by Ami’s seriousness in learning her job and her efforts to save money for their future. One day, Ryuuichi happens to see a viral video on the internet about an employee training program that has been criticized for being too extreme. In this video he sees Ami tearfully reciting the company’s motto, which makes him feel uneasy.

item.title: Mahou Shoujo wa Kiss Shite Kawaru ~Aite ga Kare Igai no Hito da Nante...~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lune Team Bitters
  • 発売日: 2013-02-22
  • スコア: 7.18/10 (73 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔法少女はキスして変身る ～相手が彼以外の人だなんて……～
  • 英語名: Mahou Shoujo wa Kiss Shite Kawaru Aite ga Kare Igai no Hito da Nante…

あらすじ

The protagonist, Kiriya Kento, has recently become romantically involved with his childhood friend, Minakami Iori. They have always known each other’s feelings, and now that they are officially a couple, they enjoy happy days together. On a holiday about a month after they started dating, Kento decides to take Iori on a date with the intention of sharing their first kiss. They spend a fun time together, feeling the different atmosphere compared to when they were just friends. As they walk home at dusk, a huge object falls from the sky with a thunderous noise just as Kento embraces Iori to kiss her. Tentacle-like appendages reach out towards the pair, and Kento is impaled while protecting Iori. As he tells Iori to run, a man appears, offering to save Kento’s life if Iori agrees to become a magical girl and fight the monster. Confused, Iori eventually accepts the man’s proposal, wanting to save Kento. In his fading consciousness, Kento sees Iori kissing the stranger and being enveloped in light.

Honda, the protagonist, is an ordinary businessman who works for a trading company as chief of the sales department.

However, Honda was a late bloomer and is inexperienced with women. Lately he is filled with uneasiness, asking himself if he is worthy of his wife, if she is satisfied with him in many ways…

别名

  • ルネソフトプレミアムパック 1＆2 セット

あらすじ

Seiji is a permanent part-timer. He has been dating a girl, Ai, for two years and he is now thinking about marrying her. But one day, he has a traffic accident and breaks his leg. Like this, he is hospitalized…. “I’ll visit you every day,” Ai says it with a smile. But their relationship gradually changes after his hospitalization…. A real estate broker who hit Seiji. A guy at the same hospital room. A handsome doctor in charge of him. A co-worker at his shop. A nurse who is his ex-girlfriend. Various people cut in on Seiji and Ai’s relationship…. Will they be able to overcome it and keep their relationship…?

item.title: Rinkan Byoutou "Yamete... Sensei, Minaide!"
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Lune Team Bitters
  • 発売日: 2005-05-27
  • スコア: 6.45/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 輪奸病棟 「やめて…先生、診ないで！」
  • 英語名: Rinkan Byoutou “Yamete… Sensei, Minaide!”

あらすじ

The protagonist, Asahina Takuma, is a highly skilled surgeon who works at one of Japan’s leading hospitals called Mansei Women’s Medical University Hospital. With his genius surgical skills, extensive network, and “dark side”, he has risen to the position of head of surgery at a young age. As a result, calls for him to be the next hospital director are increasing both inside and outside the hospital. However, a medical mistake is exposed by the media, and the current hospital director is forced to resign. In response to this situation, an election is held to select a new hospital director. The candidates are the popular and trusted head of internal medicine, Shitara Haruomi, and the protagonist, who is the head of surgery. Takuma sees this as a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and eagerly takes part in the director election that is filled with ambition and desire.
